$comment: kone's own hand-maintained pricing layer — the highest-precedence source (see resolver.ts). It exists for exactly the models neither LiteLLM nor models.dev carries at all: Cursor's own model lineup (`auto`, `composer-*`, `github_bugbot`) is never published to a third-party rate card because Cursor bills through its own subscription, not a metered API, and Cursor's `-fast` service tier for xAI's Grok isn't a uniform per-bucket multiplier (its output rate scales 3x while input/cache scale 2x), so it can't be expressed as a `fastMultiplier` the way Anthropic's and OpenAI's fast/priority tiers can (those resolve straight through LiteLLM's `provider_specific_entry.fast` / `_priority` fields — see litellmCodec.ts — and need no entry here at all).

auto.$comment: Cursor Router's own blended model, billed by Cursor directly. Source: https://cursor.com/docs/models-and-pricing.md, fetched 2026-08-11.

grok-4.5-fast.$comment: Cursor's Grok 4.5 fast-mode rate. Not expressible as a scalar fastMultiplier over the xai/grok-4.5 LiteLLM entry: input/cache scale 2x but output scales 3x, so this is its own entry rather than a multiplier on the base model.
